verdict.rationale: Fivetran's official MCP server lets users ask natural-language questions about connection and sync status through an AI model, with optional read/write/delete scopes that unlock operations such as copying connections. Its Connector SDK plugins also let users build, test and deploy connectors with natural-language prompts. However, natural-language control runs through external AI clients, is read-only by default, and is not documented as covering the full product. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, documented coverage of write operations beyond copying connections, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: It allows you to ask read-only questions like "when was the last time my postgres connection completed a sync?" and "are any of my connections broken?"
Set `FIVETRAN_SCOPE` to `read/write` or `read/write/delete` to unlock write and delete operations
These skills let you build, test, and deploy connectors using natural language prompts.
It lets you ask questions like "was my last postgres sync successful" and "are any of my connections broken" and have the model answer the questions for you.
